pages.title: MATTEL Classic Chatter Telephone - Multi
pages.description: With its friendly face, spinning dial, fun ringing-phone sounds, and eyes that move up and down as you pull it along, the Fisher-Price Chatter Telephone helps get your baby chatting—and strolling—like a pro! This classic toy will surely spark the imagination of little ones and bring back fond childhood memories for mums and dads.
